class.name: PhysXWaterPusher3D
class.brief_description: Makes a body push water aside as it moves through it: live water, seas and rivers.
class.description: Put it under a body (or point [member target] at one). Each physics tick it covers the body with spheres, from a [Skeleton3D]'s bones (spheres of [member bone_radius] along each bone, for legs and arms) or from the body's [CollisionShape3D] children (a sphere for a sphere, a row along a capsule or cylinder, a grid through a box, the bounds for other shapes), and gives the ones under the surface, up to [member max_spheres] per water, to every [PhysXLiveWater3D], [PhysXWaterSurface3D] and [PhysXRiver3D] in the scene (looked for again every 2 s). Live water takes them as displacement ([method PhysXLiveWater3D.submit_sphere]): water flows out of the body's space, heaps ahead of it and leaves a hollow and a wake behind, its volume kept. Seas and rivers take them in their ripple layer, as floating bodies do: harder near the surface and when moving ([member rest_strength] at rest, full at [member reference_speed]). For a visible wake round thin limbs, give live water a [member PhysXLiveWater3D.cell_size] of 0.25 m or less.

method.name: get_spheres
method.description: The spheres as of the last tick, world space: centre in xyz, radius in w.

method.name: get_submitted_count
method.description: How many spheres the last tick gave to the water that took the most.

members.member: Radius in m of the spheres strung along each bone of a skeleton.
When off, the body stops pushing and its spheres are taken out of the water.
At most this many spheres under the surface go to each water (at most 48), in the order they were gathered.
Speed in m/s at which a sphere pushes a sea or river at full [member strength].
How hard a still sphere pushes a sea or river, as a fraction of [member strength].
Scales the push: for live water the spheres' radius, for seas and rivers the ripple strength.
The body (or [Skeleton3D]); empty means the parent.

constants.constant: A [Skeleton3D] target uses its bones, anything else its collision shapes.
